\section{Python snippet}

\begin{minted}{python}
def fibonacci(n: int) -> int:
    """Return the nth Fibonacci number."""
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(2, n + 1):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return b

print(fibonacci(10))  # 55
\end{minted}
